known_limitations: Uses in-memory storage only; data is lost when the server restarts.
Implements a simplified role model via the X-Role header instead of full authentication and user management.
Waiting-list priority rules are basic first-in-first-out and do not implement sibling or special priority rules.
Parent-facing visibility is limited to billing statements and does not include a full parent portal.
No persistence layer, external integrations, or production-grade security hardening is included.
